userStories.title: Thread interactionBridge through the operations layer
acceptanceCriteria: `CallContext` in `src/operations/types.ts` has an optional `interactionBridge` field with shape `{ detectQuestion: (text: string) => Promise<boolean>; onQuestionDetected: (text: string) => Promise<string> }`.
`CallContext` in `src/operations/types.ts` has an optional `maxInteractionTurns?: number` field.
When `callOp` dispatches a `kind:"run"` op and `ctx.interactionBridge` is set, then `runOptions` passed to `runWithFallback` includes the `interactionBridge` value.
When `callOp` dispatches a `kind:"run"` op and `ctx.maxInteractionTurns` is set, then `runOptions` includes the `maxInteractionTurns` value.
`BuildHopCallbackContext` in `build-hop-callback.ts` has optional `interactionBridge` and `maxInteractionTurns` fields.

When `buildHopCallback` dispatches a turn via `agentManager.runAsSession(...)` and `ctx.interactionBridge` is set, then the `RunAsSessionOpts` passed to `runAsSession` includes a non-null `interactionHandler` produced by `buildRunInteractionHandler`.

When `buildHopCallback` dispatches a turn via `agentManager.runAsSession(...)` and `ctx.maxInteractionTurns` is set, then the `RunAsSessionOpts` passed to `runAsSession` includes the `maxTurns` value.
When `ctx.interactionBridge` is absent from `CallContext`, then the compiled `runOptions` does not include an `interactionBridge` key (no `undefined` spreading).
suggestedCriteria: When `ctx.maxInteractionTurns` is absent from `CallContext`, then `runOptions` does not include a `maxInteractionTurns` key (no `undefined` spreading).

When both `ctx.interactionBridge` and `contextPullTools` are set, then the `interactionHandler` produced by `buildRunInteractionHandler` handles both question-detection and context-tool-call interactions.

userStories.title: Add PlanPromptBuilder.jsonRepair() and planInteractiveOp
acceptanceCriteria: `PlanPromptBuilder` has a static method `jsonRepair(attempt: number, parseError: string): string` that returns a non-empty string containing the word "JSON".
`PlanPromptBuilder.jsonRepair()` output includes the `parseError` string passed as argument.
`planInteractiveOp` is a `RunOperation` exported from `src/operations/plan.ts` with `kind: "run"`, `name: "plan-interactive"`, and `session.role: "plan"`.
`planInteractiveOp.retry` is set and resolves to a `RetryStrategy` (not `null`) when invoked with any `PlanInteractiveInput`.
When `planInteractiveOp.parse()` receives output that is valid PRD JSON, then it returns a `PRD` object without throwing.
When `planInteractiveOp.parse()` receives output that is not valid JSON, then it throws (triggering the retry strategy).
`planInteractiveOp.hopBody` calls `ctx.sendWithParseRetry` with the initial prompt (not `ctx.send`).
`planInteractiveOp.recover` is defined and, when `outputPath` file exists on disk and contains valid PRD JSON, returns the parsed `PRD` without throwing.
When `planInteractiveOp.recover` is called and the `outputPath` file does not exist, it returns `null`.
`planOp` (`kind:"complete"`) is removed from `src/operations/plan.ts` and `src/operations/index.ts`.

escalations.reason: Reviewer contradiction: AC #10 (remove `planOp` from operations) and the scope constraint ("Out: No changes to `src/cli/plan.ts` (US-003)") are mutually incompatible — removing `planOp` from the operations barrel necessarily breaks `cli/plan.ts`'s import, requiring a change to that file to avoid 37 test failures. Reverting the `cli/plan.ts` change would restore the scope violation but break AC #10 or cause the 37 `plan.test.ts` tests to fail at module load time. The full resolution requires US-003 to also update the `plan.test.ts` mocks to use `runAsFn` when it migrates `cli/plan.ts` to `callOp(planInteractiveOp, ...)`.

suggestedCriteria: When `planInteractiveOp.parse()` receives output containing a PRD JSON wrapped in markdown code fences, it still returns a valid `PRD` (validatePlanOutput handles fence extraction).

When `planInteractiveOp.verify()` is called with a `PRD` that has at least one story, it returns the parsed PRD.
`planInteractiveOp.build()` passes `input.outputPath` to `PlanPromptBuilder.build()` so the output directive instructs the agent to write to file rather than print JSON.

userStories.title: Migrate plan.ts to callOp + planInteractiveOp; remove --auto and runAs
acceptanceCriteria: `src/cli/plan.ts` does not contain any call to `agentManager.runAs(...)`.
`src/cli/plan.ts` does not contain an `options.auto` branch or the `--auto` flag handling.
`src/cli/plan.ts` does not contain the `runInteractivePlan` inner function.
When `planCommand()` is called (non-debate path), then it calls `callOp(ctx, planInteractiveOp, input)` where `ctx.interactionBridge` is set from the resolved interaction chain.
When `planCommand()` is called and `interactionChain` is `null`, then `ctx.interactionBridge` is set from `_planDeps.createInteractionBridge()` (the stdin fallback).
When `planCommand()` calls `callOp` for the interactive path, then `ctx.maxInteractionTurns` is set from `config?.agent?.maxInteractionTurns`.
When the debate fallback fires (all debaters fail), then the fallback calls `callOp(ctx, planInteractiveOp, input)` instead of `runInteractivePlan()`.
When `callOp + planInteractiveOp` succeeds and the agent has written a valid PRD to `outputPath`, then `planCommand()` returns the `outputPath` string.
When `callOp + planInteractiveOp` throws and `outputPath` does not exist on disk, then `planCommand()` propagates the error.
`import { planOp }` is removed from `src/cli/plan.ts`; `planInteractiveOp` is imported instead.
suggestedCriteria: When `callOp + planInteractiveOp` throws and `outputPath` DOES exist on disk (agent wrote to file before session ended), then `planCommand()` returns `outputPath` without re-throwing.
When `planCommand()` exits (success or failure), `interactionChain.destroy()` is called if the chain was initialized.
When `planCommand()` exits (success or failure), `rt.close()` is called on the plan runtime.
`resolvePlanModelSelection` is no longer called inside `planCommand()` after migration (model resolution moves into `planInteractiveOp.model`).
`PlanCommandOptions` no longer has the `auto?: boolean` field after migration.

analysis:
## Key Files and Impact Areas

### US-001: Thread interactionBridge through the operations layer

**`src/operations/types.ts` — `CallContext` interface (lines 15–39):**
`CallContext` has no `interactionBridge` or `maxInteractionTurns` fields. Both must be added as optional fields. The shape of `interactionBridge` matches `AgentRunOptions.interactionBridge` in `src/agents/types.ts` (lines 103–107): `{ detectQuestion: (text: string) => Promise<boolean>; onQuestionDetected: (text: string) => Promise<string> }`.

**`src/operations/call.ts` — `runOptions` assembly for kind:"run" ops (lines 201–212):**
The `runOptions` object built for `runWithFallback` does NOT include `interactionBridge` or `maxInteractionTurns`. Both must be spread in conditionally (no `undefined` spreading — use `...(ctx.interactionBridge ? { interactionBridge: ctx.interactionBridge } : {})` pattern).
The `hopCtx` object (lines 215–226) is the `BuildHopCallbackContext` passed to `buildHopCallback`. It also does NOT include `interactionBridge` or `maxInteractionTurns`. Both must be added here too.

**`src/operations/build-hop-callback.ts` — `BuildHopCallbackContext` + `send` closure (lines 32–56 and 179–189):**
`BuildHopCallbackContext` has no `interactionBridge` or `maxInteractionTurns` fields — add both as optional.
The `send` closure calls `agentManager.runAsSession(agentName, handle, turnPrompt, { ... })` but does NOT pass `interactionHandler` or `maxTurns` to `RunAsSessionOpts`. After the change, `buildRunInteractionHandler` (from `../agents/acp/adapter-output` or `../agents/acp/adapter`) must be called with the interaction bridge and context tool options to produce the `interactionHandler`. Pass `maxTurns: maxInteractionTurns` when the field is set.

**`src/agents/acp/adapter-output.ts` — `buildRunInteractionHandler` (line 123):**
This function accepts `AgentRunOptions` and builds an `InteractionHandler` that handles both context-tool calls and `interactionBridge` Q&A. Currently used only in `src/runtime/session-run-hop.ts`. Must be imported and called in `build-hop-callback.ts`. Note: `session-run-hop.ts` imports from `"../agents/acp/adapter"` not `"../agents/acp/adapter-output"` — implementer must check the correct import path.

**`src/agents/manager-types.ts` — `RunAsSessionOpts` (lines 91–111):**
`RunAsSessionOpts` already has `interactionHandler?: InteractionHandler` (line 104) and `maxTurns?: number` (line 106). No changes needed here — these just need to be populated by `buildHopCallback`.

### US-002: Add PlanPromptBuilder.jsonRepair() and planInteractiveOp

**`src/prompts/builders/plan-builder.ts` — `PlanPromptBuilder` class:**
The class has one instance method `build()` and zero static methods. Add a static method `jsonRepair(attempt: number, parseError: string): string`. Biome's `noStaticOnlyClass` rule allows static methods alongside instance methods — `ReviewPromptBuilder` follows this same pattern (has both instance and static methods). The method returns a repair prompt telling the agent its previous response was not valid JSON, includes the `parseError` string, and asks it to re-write the PRD JSON to `outputPath`.

**`src/operations/plan.ts` — existing `planOp`:**
`planOp` is a `CompleteOperation<PlanOpInput, PRD, PlanConfig>` (kind:"complete"). It must be REPLACED with `planInteractiveOp` as a `RunOperation<PlanInteractiveInput, PRD, PlanConfig>` (kind:"run").
`PlanInteractiveInput` extends `PlanOpInput` by adding an `outputPath: string` field — the file path the agent is asked to write the PRD to. This enables:
(a) `build()` to pass `outputPath` to `PlanPromptBuilder.build()` so the agent writes to file rather than printing JSON
(b) `op.recover` to read from that file on session failure

**`src/agents/retry/parse-retry.ts` — `makeParseRetryStrategy`:**
`makeParseRetryStrategy` is used by `semanticReviewOp` and `adversarialReviewOp` as the canonical JSON parse retry pattern for `RunOperation`s. `planInteractiveOp` uses the same pattern. `prompts.invalid()` and `prompts.truncated()` in the opts should call `PlanPromptBuilder.jsonRepair(...)` with appropriate repair text. The `validate` function checks if the parsed object is a valid PRD (has `userStories` array, etc.) — a lightweight structural check without calling full `validatePlanOutput`. The `exhaustedFallback` should be omitted or return undefined — `op.recover` handles disk fallback when verify fails.

**`src/prd/schema.ts` — `validatePlanOutput`:**
`validatePlanOutput(output, featureName, branchName)` is the authoritative PRD parser. It handles markdown extraction, trailing commas, LLM quirks, complexity normalization, and forces status→pending. Called in `op.parse(output, input, _ctx)`. Throws on invalid JSON — this is intentional and triggers the retry strategy via `ParseValidationError`.

**`op.verify` + `op.recover` pattern:**
`op.verify` should return null when the output-parsed PRD lacks `userStories` entries (indicating the agent may have written a richer version to disk but truncated its output). `op.recover` reads `input.outputPath` from disk, calls `validatePlanOutput` on the file contents, and returns the PRD or null. This matches `runPostParse` behavior: `verify → null → recover` is the recovery path for soft failures (agent wrote to file but stdout was truncated). For hard failures (session abort/timeout), `plan.ts` catches `callOp` errors and reads from disk — same behavior as the current `runInteractivePlan()` error recovery.

**IMPORTANT — exhaustedFallback constraint:**
`makeParseRetryStrategy`'s `exhaustedFallback` is synchronous. Bun has no synchronous file-read API. Therefore, `exhaustedFallback` MUST NOT attempt async disk reads. Omit it or have it return `undefined`. The disk-fallback for retry exhaustion is handled at the `plan.ts` level (try-catch around `callOp`).

**IMPORTANT — `noStaticOnlyClass` vs static method:**
Biome's `noStaticOnlyClass` only fires when ALL class members are static. `PlanPromptBuilder` has the instance method `build()`, so adding a static `jsonRepair()` is safe.

### US-003: Migrate plan.ts; remove --auto and runAs

**`src/cli/plan.ts` — full file:**
Current structure:
- `PlanCommandOptions.auto?: boolean` field
- `options.auto` branch at lines 173–214 (calls `callOp + planOp` via completeAs)
- `runInteractivePlan()` inner function at lines 220–301 (calls `agentManager.runAs()` directly)
- Debate fallback at line 171: `rawResponse = await runInteractivePlan()`
- Final `rawResponse` validated at line 305 via `validatePlanOutput(rawResponse, ...)`

After migration:
- Remove `auto?: boolean` from `PlanCommandOptions`
- Remove the `options.auto` branch entirely
- Remove the `runInteractivePlan()` inner function
- Replace both with a single `callOp(ctx, planInteractiveOp, input)` call where `ctx.interactionBridge` is resolved from `interactionChain` (or stdin fallback) and `ctx.maxInteractionTurns` comes from `config?.agent?.maxInteractionTurns`
- The debate fallback replaces `rawResponse = await runInteractivePlan()` with a `callOp + planInteractiveOp` call
- Remove the `rawResponse` variable and the final `validatePlanOutput(rawResponse, ...)` call — validation is now inside `planInteractiveOp.parse()`
- The returned PRD is written to `outputPath` via `_planDeps.writeFile`
- Wrap `callOp` in try-catch; on error, attempt disk read from `outputPath` (preserving current error recovery)

**`src/cli/plan-runtime.ts` — `resolvePlanModelSelection`:**
After migration, model resolution moves into `planInteractiveOp.model`. `resolvePlanModelSelection` is still exported (for backward compat) but no longer called inside `planCommand()`. `createPlanRuntime` is still needed for the `NaxRuntime`.

**`src/operations/index.ts` — barrel:**
Remove `export { planOp } from "./plan"` and `export type { PlanOpInput }`. Add `export { planInteractiveOp } from "./plan"` and `export type { PlanInteractiveInput }` from "./plan".

**`src/interaction/bridge-builder.ts`:**
`buildInteractionBridge(chain, opts)` is already used in current `runInteractivePlan()`. In the migrated code, this call moves to `planCommand()` scope and the bridge is passed as `ctx.interactionBridge`.

**Risk: debate path**
The debate fallback path currently calls `runInteractivePlan()` (inner function). After removal, the fallback must call `callOp(ctx, planInteractiveOp, input)` directly — same `ctx` shape as the non-debate path. The `debateRt` runtime is already created before this point; the `callCtx` for the fallback can be built from it.

**Risk: rawResponse flow change**
The current non-debate interactive path returns `rawResponse` (a string) which is then validated at the bottom of `planCommand()`. After migration, `callOp` returns a `PRD` directly — the validation step at the bottom must be removed or replaced with a write of the already-validated PRD.

**Risk: rt.close() / pidRegistry cleanup**
The current `runInteractivePlan()` does explicit cleanup (`pidRegistry.killAll`, `interactionChain.destroy`, `rt.close()`). After migration, `rt.close()` is still needed in a finally block around `callOp`. `interactionChain.destroy()` and `pidRegistry.killAll()` must still be called in finally.

**Tests to check:**
- `test/unit/cli/plan.test.ts` — if it exists, covers `planCommand()` behavior
- `test/unit/operations/plan.test.ts` — covers `planOp`; must be updated for `planInteractiveOp`
- `test/unit/operations/call.test.ts` — may need new test for `interactionBridge` threading
